entities.name: Olga Orman
entities.label: Person
entities.summary: Olga Orman was a Dutch-Aruban writer, poet and storyteller. She wrote both in Papiamento and Dutch. Orman introduced kamishibai, a Japanese form of storytelling, to the Netherlands and the ABC islands.
